description: Automated dependency updates. Scoped to nuxt-app for now; see docs/dependency-upgrade-plan.md. Add directus-cms to includePaths once the nuxt-app phases are done.

major.description: Majors never open a PR on their own. They appear on the dependency dashboard and are created only when someone ticks the box — which is how the upgrade plan's phases stay one-per-PR.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the schedule and the dashboard-approval gate entirely.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh transitive dependencies monthly so the lockfile does not silently rot between direct-dependency bumps.
schedule: before 07:00 on the first monday of the month

packageRules.description: Nuxt framework and first-party modules move together — bumping them piecemeal is how peer-dependency mismatches happen.
Lint and format tooling. Non-runtime, so grouping them keeps the PR count down.
Type definitions only — never affects runtime behaviour.
@nuxt/image-edge is an abandoned nightly channel; chasing its tags produces pure noise. Phase 3 of the upgrade plan removes the package — delete this rule then.
Tailwind is deliberately held at v3. Moving to v4 is a config-format rewrite tracked as Phase 6, not a routine bump.
